reviewer_scope: Independent anonymous reviewer one, T3, d0. No arm assignment, other reviewer output, earlier study, self-review or desired result was read. No delegation or agent messages were used.
reference: Approved public design-v2/T3/public BRIEF/API, original reference PNGs, source-backed reference.json propositions, lock, policy, public fixtures/actions/bindings and source capsules referenced in the eight inputs. Candidate screenshots are not references for another candidate.

coverage.visual_inspection: All 56 labeled state contact sheets were viewed, including the entire long content in both caller scenarios, all choices/reasons/details, opened guidance, summaries, updated notices and footers. All selected qualitative-state PNGs were inspected as viewport crops of originals; enlarged P2 page slices were used for legibility. Original unmodified PNGs were also opened directly for the Android P2 disclosure and iOS disabled primary fill. The 416 nonselected acquisition/action frames were read through their original observation metadata and action/dispatch bindings, not all exhaustively viewed. Originals remain unchanged in the referenced corpus roots; input-hashes.json pins the exact originals and inputs.
coverage.derivation_limits: Contact sheets crop only the recorded viewport and resize it for review, with source/platform/case/state/index/offset labels; they do not stitch away gaps or replace target content. Native full coverage comes only from frozen bound_state_evidence, not image existence, sheet existence, bottom sentinel or source. Initial sheet summaries were large and resized; P2 full-content state portions were subsequently inspected at larger legible size. The incomplete source-a iOS P2 submitted interval union was preserved despite a visible final footer.

clusters: Both sources, Android P2: rounded disclosure clips leading glyphs on both lines of Show/Hide handover notes. Original fully visible control images show the same cuts at distinct scroll positions. This fails word-clipping and no-occlusion propositions, with one common cause across their manifestations; separate blocks otherwise do not collide.

Both sources, iOS P1/P2 baseline: disabled primary background is visibly dimmed; frozen side-strip pixel samples are solid and suitable inside the actual primary control. Source specifies the expected palette but native disabled presentation alters the rendered component-owned fill. Mechanism is inferred, raw contradiction is measured.

Source-a iOS P1/P2: authoritative caller revision selects b, but replacement displays no selection/zero summary/disabled action. Later a toggle and submit retain only a. The actual incoming fixture, changed notice, successful dispatch and coherent state bindings support a component revision-state defect. Related summary, enablement, fill and callback rows are manifestations, not independent bugs.

uncertainty_and_contradictions: Source-a iOS P1 submitted wrapping is null because required incoming wheel-selection summary content is absent, despite legible wrapping of every actually drawn word. The wrapping proposition explicitly says missing required text cannot earn a pass.

Source-a iOS P2 submitted wrapping and overlap are null because its exact full-content interval union is incomplete; missing wheel-selection summary content independently prevents a wrapping pass. Bound target facts and callback failures remain supported and are separately attributed.

Source-a iOS P2 reselected also has incomplete full-state coverage. Its selected assertions are target facts, and exact coherent target frames support their native failures. No qualitative full-page decision was added to that target-only state.

Narrow iOS labels sometimes break long words between characters. No character loss or ellipsis is visible; the approved brief explicitly allows character breaks for an overwide unbroken segment. This does not certify arbitrary other text or line widths.
iOS computed title weight remains unsupported U. No visual font or numeric geometry substitute was submitted. Pixel/native facts are recomputed by frozen tools, not voted away.

Visual overlap false for Android P2 concerns curved-boundary occlusion of disclosure glyphs, not collisions between separate content blocks. The wrapping failure concerns the same visible clipping; it is not counted as another independent cause.

No other reviewer was read, so panel disagreement cannot be measured here. The evaluator was given this one identical request in both slots only for schema/identity self-check; agreement there is not independent consensus or human gold.
schema_self_check: One frozen acceptance.evaluate invocation per source/platform/case, identical own judge in both slots. All eight accepted. No outcome was altered to achieve a green report; no schema rejection occurred.
authored_output_boundary: All authored files are under judgments/d0/one/T3. No production changes, SDK acquisitions, commits or external messages were made. Initial Python imports used pre-existing bytecode cache; a stat check found no frozen-script bytecode file modified after actual reviewer start. Later Python commands used -B.
rejected_attempts: Two read/inspection mistakes are preserved in rejected-attempts: a step-summary KeyError from assuming an iOS field on Android steps, and an incorrect guessed image suffix. Both were resolved by reading the actual observation paths/keys. Large-output truncations were resolved with targeted reads. No rejected judge JSON exists.
